scripts.build: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs=>{fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true});const files=['index.html','_redirects','sw.js','manifest.json','icon.svg','pwa-192x192.png','pwa-512x512.png','apple-touch-icon.png'];files.forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync(f))fs.copyFileSync(f,'dist/'+f);});console.log('Build complete: static assets and service worker ready in dist/');})"
